name: Sagrada

categories.label: Private objective
categories.help: Sum of the values of your secret colour on your window.

categories.label: Public objectives
categories.help: Points from the shared objective cards you met.

categories.label: Favour tokens
categories.help: One point for each unused favour token.

categories.label: Empty spaces
categories.help: Window spaces left empty, each costing one point.

notes: The final tie-break (reverse player order in the last round) is not modelled; anything left is shared. Solo play scores differently (no favour tokens, -3 per empty space, target score) and is not supported.
